rule: Names resolve in definition order through local bindings, local opens, enclosing structures and their opens/includes, module aliases (`module F = Filegen.Make (P)`) and dune library wrappers (`Functoria.DSL`); then Stdlib (`Stdlib.invalid_arg`), the innermost external local open, the one external open (medium); `List.length` medium; applying a parameter is unknown.
notes: `printf` is not a Stdlib top-level value; the file has one external open (`open Printf`), so it resolves to `Printf.printf`, medium. Inside `join`, `concat` and `basename` are not Stdlib top-level values and resolve to the innermost external local open `Filename`: `Filename.concat`, `Filename.basename`, medium. The `open` declarations are module dependencies, not calls.
